description: Plant-identification coverage. 'identifiable' and 'diagnosable' are separate and never inferred from each other. Plants outside the vocabulary are not supported. No universal plant recognition is claimed.

outside_vocabulary.behaviour: the adapter should refuse; wrong acceptances are possible and are measured only on development data until the sealed evaluation is authorised

identifiable.basis: no authorised sealed protocol-v2 evaluation yet; the retired pilot is not evidence

diagnosable.basis: frozen six-crop disease classifier scope (knowledge base), independent of identification
